history.body: Hi, saw the Pearl Residences ad. We’re renting now and starting to look at our first place. What’s the layout like?

Pearl Residences’ Type A is 900 sq. ft., with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The living, dining and kitchen areas are open-plan, with an entrance foyer for a little extra privacy. Are you looking for your own stay or investment?
For our own stay. How are the three bedrooms arranged?

The illustrated layout shows space for a queen-sized bed in each of the three bedrooms, and the master bedroom concept also allows for a walk-in wardrobe. Would you like to come and see the layout? Would weekdays or weekends suit you better?
It could be worth a look, especially if the extra rooms feel practical for us long term. Weekends are usually easier.
Great, weekends sound good. I’ll have our team help arrange a viewing and confirm a suitable time with you. It’ll be a good chance to see how practical the three-bedroom layout feels in person.
